description: Secret field-name phrases for the Chrome extension redaction layers (content.js, network_redact.js, extension_evidence.py, extension_network.py). A field name, id, aria-label, autocomplete value or JSON key is split into lowercase tokens (camelCase and PascalCase boundaries, then any run of non-alphanumeric characters) and is secret when a phrase appears in it as whole consecutive tokens. content.js and network_redact.js embed an identical copy of this list; tests/test_extension_secret_field_names.py fails when they differ. 'code' alone is deliberately absent: only an identifier that is exactly 'code' is secret.
